Skill documentation

Reference pages for the skills that live in this repository. Each one documents what the skill does, what it needs installed, and where it stops.

Sources: github.com/Agents365-ai/365-skills, one folder per skill under plugins/*/docs/.

  • mermaidtext to diagram

    Mermaid source from a description, validated before export, rendered to PNG / SVG / PDF.

    English 中文
  • excalidrawhand-drawn diagram

    Excalidraw scenes written as JSON, exported through Kroki or the local CLI, sketchy or clean.

    English 中文
  • plantumluml diagram

    Sequence, class, ER, activity and C4 diagrams through Kroki, or a local jar when you are offline.

    English 中文
  • tldrawwhiteboard diagram

    Whiteboard-style .tldr scenes with a vision self-check pass before you see the result.

    English 中文
  • imagencnimage generation

    Every supported image model in one table: resolution, price and what each one is good at.

    Model reference
  • ttscntext to speech

    15 speech backends side by side: cost per 10k characters, voices, cloning, streaming support.

    Provider comparison
  • agent-native-designcli design contract

    The 14-criterion contract for command-line tools an agent can actually operate, with a review workflow.

    English 中文
Built from the plugin folders in this repository: the Pages workflow copies every plugins/*/docs/ directory into its own path here, so a site is edited next to the skill it documents.
